title: Brown's paper The Structure of Space, written at Martin Corporation

tellings.quote: Townsend Brown's scientific paper, which we do have access to, is called the structure of space, which he wrote in the early '40s while working at Martin Corporation.

plain: The inventor Thomas Townsend Brown wrote a scientific paper called The Structure of Space in the early 1940s, while he was working at Martin Corporation, an American aircraft maker. Michels tells this himself in a documentary about Brown and notes that the paper still survives and can be read. It matters to him because it shows Brown working on ideas about space and propulsion long before later claims about secret flying craft.
